description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Accounts module in SuiteCRM. It contains unit tests for various methods within the Account class, including query generation, data retrieval, and method behaviors.

classes.name: AccountTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various functionalities of the Account class in SuiteCRM.

methods.description: Initializes test environment, including global variables and default configuration.

methods.name: testgetProductsServicesPurchasedQuery

methods.description: Verifies the instantiation and type of the Account bean.
